# Tab library

TeamHub ships 28 optional tabs. Pick any combination in the setup wizard; tabs you don't pick add **zero bytes** to
your site and **zero tables** to your database. Each tab has one clear purpose and says what it is *not* for, so
features never overlap.

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:modules` — edit the module manifests and READMEs instead. -->

## Team

| Tab | Purpose | Not for | Stores | Uses files | Prefix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Announcements](../../modules/announcements/README.md) | One-way messages to the team. | Discussion (there are no replies); Questions that need answers; Collecting personal info; A library of links | Posts, an optional image each, and read receipts only for “must read” posts. | Yes | `ann_` |
| [Attendance](../../modules/attendance/README.md) | Record who came to practices. | Planning who will come; Scheduling practices | Practice sessions and who was present (absence is never stored). |  | `att_` |
| [Bulletin Board](../../modules/bulletin/README.md) | Browse the team's links and resources. | Announcements; Storing files; Discussion | Nothing new: it shows and organizes the program’s single links list. |  | `bul_` |
| [Calendar](../../modules/calendar/README.md) | When things happen — practices, meetings, competitions, deadlines and socials. | RSVPs or finding a time that works; Claiming limited slots (drivers, snacks); Discussion | Events with optional repeat rules; iCal feed links for families. |  | `cal_` |
| [Paperwork Tracker](../../modules/paperwork/README.md) | Track who has turned in required paperwork. | Uploading or collecting the documents themselves; Asking questions | The list of required forms and who has turned each in. Never the documents. |  | `ppr_` |
| [Polls & Availability](../../modules/polls/README.md) | Make a group decision or find a time that works. | Collecting personal info (sizes, allergies, contacts); Claiming limited slots; Required paperwork; Announcements | Polls, answers until 30 days after closing, and the final totals. |  | `poll_` |
| [Sign-up Sheets](../../modules/signups/README.md) | Claim one of a limited number of slots. | Opinions or availability; Collecting info; Assigning work | Sheets, their slots and who claimed each one. |  | `sign_` |
| [Skills & Training](../../modules/skills/README.md) | Record proven abilities with a sign-off. | Job titles and responsibilities; Tracking work | The skill list and who signed off whom, when. |  | `skill_` |
| [Tasks](../../modules/tasks/README.md) | Assign and track team work. | Buying things; Getting a part made; Logging breakages; Step-by-step lists | Tasks with assignees, subteam, due date and status; comments on tasks. |  | `task_` |

## Engineering

| Tab | Purpose | Not for | Stores | Uses files | Prefix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Battery Tracker](../../modules/batteries/README.md) | Keep batteries charged and healthy. | General parts inventory | Your batteries and a short log of charges, voltage tests and use. |  | `bat_` |
| [Code Hub](../../modules/code-hub/README.md) | The software team's home: repo activity, OpModes and controls. | Storing code; Documenting design decisions | Your OpModes with status and gamepad mappings. Commits come live from GitHub. |  | `code_` |
| [Driver Practice](../../modules/driver-practice/README.md) | Track our own practice driving performance. | Scouting other teams | Practice runs: drivers, scores and the metrics your team chooses. |  | `drv_` |
| [Engineering Notebook](../../modules/notebook/README.md) | The single place to document engineering work, design versions and decisions. | To-dos; Announcements; Storing CAD or big files | Log entries and design iterations (with decision matrices), subsystems, up to 6 compressed photos per entry. | Yes | `nb_` |
| [Parts Inventory](../../modules/inventory/README.md) | What parts we have and where they are. | Buying parts; Batteries | Parts with SKU, vendor link, bin location, quantity and a low-stock level. No images. |  | `inv_` |
| [Purchase Requests](../../modules/purchases/README.md) | Ask a mentor to buy something, and see its status. | Budgets or accounting; General to-dos; Getting a part made | Requests (item, link, quantity, estimated price, reason) and their order status. No budgets. |  | `pur_` |
| [Repair & Issue Log](../../modules/repairs/README.md) | Record what broke, why, and how it was fixed — history and portfolio material. | Assigning the fix to someone | Issues with subsystem, severity, cause, fix and an optional photo. | Yes | `rep_` |
| [To Manufacture](../../modules/manufacture/README.md) | Get a part made by the person responsible for that machine. | Buying parts; General to-dos; Storing CAD files | Jobs (method, quantity, material, status) and their model files until they are made. | Yes | `mfg_` |

## Competition

| Tab | Purpose | Not for | Stores | Uses files | Prefix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Checklists](../../modules/checklists/README.md) | Run through a list of steps, again and again. | Assigning work to people; Interview practice | Checklists with sections and items, and recent runs (who ticked what). |  | `chk_` |
| [Competition Day](../../modules/competition-day/README.md) | The live screen at an event. | Chat (pit notes are short status text); Scouting other teams | Which event each team is at, pit notes, and a history of past events (kept until an admin deletes it). |  | `comp_` |
| [Events & Results](../../modules/events/README.md) | Official competition results and stats from FTCScout. | Entering results by hand; Travel planning and discussion | Only the team's own short notes per event. |  | `evt_` |
| [Judging Prep](../../modules/judging/README.md) | Practice interviews and track award evidence. | Judging and portfolio checklists; Writing engineering content | An interview question bank and award criteria with links to evidence. |  | `jdg_` |
| [Rules Reference](../../modules/rules/README.md) | Track rule questions/clarifications and rules worth remembering. | Hosting the game manual; General Q&A or chat | Questions with answers and sources, and short rule reminders, tagged by season. |  | `rule_` |
| [Scouting](../../modules/scouting/README.md) | Scout other teams and build a pick list. | Our own practice data | Your season's match/pit forms, every scouting entry, and pick lists per event. |  | `sct_` |

## Outreach & Business

| Tab | Purpose | Not for | Stores | Uses files | Prefix |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Media Gallery](../../modules/media/README.md) | Share team photos and video links. | File storage or backups; Documents | Albums, compressed photos and links to videos/albums elsewhere. | Yes | `med_` |
| [Merch & Orders](../../modules/merch/README.md) | Collect team merch orders. | Collecting sizes for other reasons; Taking payments (collect money outside TeamHub) | Order drives and each person’s order lines, plus paid/delivered checkboxes. Never payment details. |  | `mer_` |
| [Outreach Log](../../modules/outreach/README.md) | Log outreach events, hours and people reached. | Scheduling in general (outreach shows on the calendar automatically); Photos | Outreach events and each person’s hours. |  | `out_` |
| [Social Media Planner](../../modules/social/README.md) | Plan posts from idea to draft, approval, scheduled and posted. | Storing photos and videos; Posting automatically (copy the caption and post it yourself) | Post ideas, captions, links to media and their status. |  | `soc_` |
| [Sponsors CRM](../../modules/sponsors/README.md) | Track sponsor relationships and follow-ups. | Money accounting (write “what they gave” in words) | Sponsor names, contacts, status and next steps. Captains and mentors only. |  | `spn_` |

“Uses files” tabs store compressed uploads in Supabase Storage (see the Admin > Storage meter).

## Integrations

Small units that switch on automatically when both tabs are enabled:

| Integration | What it adds |
|---|---|
| `attendance+calendar` | Practices on the calendar get a one-tap "Take attendance" button, and sessions remember which event they belong to. |
| `competition-day+checklists` | Competition Day shows your robot/pit checklists with today’s progress. |
| `competition-day+scouting` | “Scout this match” on Competition Day opens Scouting on the right event and match; partners show your scouting. |
| `events+calendar` | Your FTCScout competitions appear on the calendar automatically (merged with any calendar event that has the same event code). |
| `judging+checklists` | Judging Prep shows shortcuts to your judging/pit and portfolio checklists. |
| `manufacture+inventory` | Finished parts can be added to the parts inventory. |
| `notebook+code-hub` | "Add to notebook" on code-hub items creates a pre-filled notebook entry that links back to it. |
| `notebook+driver-practice` | "Add to notebook" on driver-practice items creates a pre-filled notebook entry that links back to it. |
| `notebook+manufacture` | "Add to notebook" on manufacture items creates a pre-filled notebook entry that links back to it. |
| `notebook+outreach` | “Add to notebook” on outreach events creates a pre-filled notebook entry that links back. |
| `notebook+repairs` | "Add to notebook" on repairs items creates a pre-filled notebook entry that links back to it. |
| `outreach+calendar` | Outreach events appear on the calendar automatically (read-only overlay — nothing is copied). |
| `polls+calendar` | Ask a poll about a calendar event (“Can you come?”); the event links to its polls. |
| `purchases+inventory` | Received purchases can be added to the parts inventory in one tap. |
| `repairs+inventory` | Record which parts a repair used; they are taken out of inventory. |
| `signups+calendar` | Attach a sign-up sheet to a calendar event; the event shows its sheets and how full they are. |
| `social+calendar` | Scheduled social posts appear on the calendar (read-only overlay). |
| `tasks+calendar` | Task due dates appear on the calendar (read-only overlay — nothing is copied). |
